situation: Start at the board address #/ with the default data and let the clock run 2200 ms, so that every column has loaded.
Put focus on SL-114 and press Enter to open it. Let the clock run 300 ms.
Click the "Add a comment" field, type "draft", press Enter, then press Escape.
question: What is the address, which part has focus, and was a comment sent?
answer: The card stays open at #/card/SL-114 with focus in the comment field (Escape there does nothing; Enter adds a line). No comment was sent.
